title: In what way if any are you a tech minimalist while maintaining your job/love for tech?
description: <p>Curious what others think about this recently popular lifestyle shift. I love my coding, selfhosting, and useful tools but I’ve found myself moving towards “low” tech solutions such as pen and paper or just micro, iPod, a physical calendar versus all these different SaaS and selfhosted services.</p>
raw_content:
In what way if any are you a tech minimalist while maintaining your job/love for tech?
<p>Curious what others think about this recently popular lifestyle shift. I love my coding, selfhosting, and useful tools but I’ve found myself moving towards “low” tech solutions such as pen and paper or just micro, iPod, a physical calendar versus all these different SaaS and selfhosted services.</p>
